description: Linear personal API keys (lin_api_ + 40 chars) committed in a Next.js feedback route that files Linear issues, and as a literal fallback after process.env (`process.env.LINEAR_API_KEY ?? "lin_api_…"`) in a roadmap sync job. Both are hardcoded keys with full read/write access to the workspace. VC176 fires on the route. The fallback is a knownGap: the shared prefix-rule helper (secretRuleCheck) skips any line that mentions process.env, so a full-format key literal on that same line is never reported — fixing it means changing the placeholder filter for every prefix-based secret rule, not just VC176.
